originalSourceText:
Q.6  Why is 3𝑓3 = 0 and 3𝑛 3 = 0 used as a boundary condition
      in the inward iteration of 2 DOF planar manipulator example
     shown below?

     A) Because link 2 is assumed massless

     B) Because there is no external force or moment applied by the
     environment at the end-effector

     C) Because the base is not rotating

     D) Because the manipulator is in static equilibrium

     Answer: B
      Refer to Lecture 13: Newton – Euler’s Equation: Examples
      Slide 5
